full_page.content:
Page 20 Cont. Mar. 9 Mary Eliz. Frederick - 72 - in Providence H. - like burning up with fever. Drs. not certain just what it may be. . . Enrolled This A.M. at 10:10 perpet. member - 11th - Child M. E. F. Sitting up To-day - playing. Fever gone at 3 P.M. same day
10 Nette Smith - 61 - Very charitable - convert - in Harper Hosp. in dying con'n
Thom. Lane - 16 - Vanished last Monday
Page 21
Mar. 15 Richard Chauvin - 58 - threatening divorce proceeding after 35 yrs. Wife heart-sick at his continual refusal to speak ... Enrolled To- night 50¢
Catherine (Mrs.) Lewis - 30 - fears operation - Mother of two small children is anxious to live for her family. Enrolled To-day prom- ising perpetual ... if things turn favorably
16 Mrs. Marg. Kennedy - 76 - trying to make honest living by keeping roomers and has a very weak foot.
16 Peter Krost - 15 - lukemia, given up by Drs as hopeless last Wednes- day 11th. Went over to Prov. Hospital about 11 P.M ..... decidedly improved ...
Mary Jane Krentler - 23 - spinal trouble; fell about five years ago - lost part of spine ... felt well for a time, but now nerveous, etc.
Miss Doris McDonald - 19 - like a stroke two yrs. ago. Worse re- cently - getting quite helpless ....
Clemens Bober - 25 - orphan, has worked on farm 8 yrs. - no home Mrs. Blay - 48 - asks prayers for her baby born yesterday and still in danger ...
Page 22 March 25th Annunciation
Mar. Dorothy Cray - 21 - threatened with blindness. ...
Mar. 21 Mary Peltier - 59 - cancer of lung .. ...
22 Arthur Hanswirth - 35 - hurt several years ago playing foot-ball. Only about two years ago it became really serious. Now the victim is a total invalid. He hopes, however, in prayer .... Enrolled in Ser Mass Assoc.
